d: For a prestigious ultra-luxury hospitality operation in Dubai, Ali Professional is looking internationally for an exceptional:
This is an opportunity for a hospitality leader capable of combining uncompromising guest experience with commercial performance, brand positioning and extraordinary people leadership.
A General Manager who does not simply operate a five-star property.
Someone who understands how to make it unforgettable.
You will assume full leadership of the property, taking responsibility for:
q: Your mission will be to position the property among Dubai’s most recognised luxury hospitality destinations.
Assume full responsibility for the property’s financial and operational performance
Lead annual budgeting, forecasting and strategic planning
Monitor RevPAR, ADR, occupancy and key commercial indicators
Identify new revenue opportunities across rooms, F&B and ancillary services
Ensure disciplined cost management without compromising the luxury experience
Ensure exceptional standards across Rooms, F&B, Guest Relations, Housekeeping, Spa and supporting functions
Establish operational standards aligned with international luxury benchmarks
Personally oversee critical VIP and high-profile guest experiences
Drive continuous improvement across every guest touchpoint
Lead and inspire the Executive Committee
Develop succession plans for critical positions
Ensure strong engagement across a multicultural workforce
Create an environment where excellence becomes a daily habit
Work closely with Sales, Marketing and Revenue teams
Strengthen the property’s positioning within Dubai’s competitive luxury market
Build relationships with international partners, luxury travel networks and key stakeholders
Develop innovative experiences capable of generating visibility and loyalty
Represent the property within the local and international hospitality ecosystem
At this level, luxury is not about offering more.
You will ensure the organisation anticipates guests’ expectations rather than simply responding to them.
Every guest becomes an opportunity to strengthen the reputation of the property.
We are interested in meeting exceptional hospitality executives with
Significant General Manager / Hotel Manager leadership experience
Proven background within luxury or ultra-luxury 5★ hospitality
Strong knowledge of rooms and F&B operations
Proven commercial and revenue management mindset
Strong track record in guest experience
Previous Middle East experience will be considered a strong advantage
Pre-opening, repositioning or major transformation experience will be particularly valued.
BUT WE ARE LOOKING FOR MORE THAN EXPERIENCE.
The ability to walk through a lobby and immediately understand what needs to change.
The ability to sit with investors in the morning, lead 300+ people in the afternoon and welcome an international VIP guest in the evening.
Because at this level, hospitality leadership is not a job description.
Final compensation will be defined according to the candidate’s international track record and the scope of the assignment.
Because few hospitality markets in the world demand this combination of:
speed, ambition, luxury, innovation and performance.
Dubai is not simply a destination.
For hospitality leaders, it can become a global stage.
And we are looking for someone ready to step onto it.
🇦🇪 YOUR NEXT PROPERTY COULD CHANGE YOUR CAREER.
GENERAL MANAGER ULTRA-LUXURY HOTEL DUBAI | UAE
And if this isn’t your next role, stay close.
Rome. Lugano. Dubai. And this is only today’s map.
Tomorrow, another city could become your next career move.
